title: SCRATCHED: Three Days Out
author: GatorVault Staff
excerpt: Eight days out, Florida had a shape you could hold. Two Swamp nights put names on it. Saturday at Auburn is the first game on the slate that actually matches the season.
takeaways: This is the sequel to Eight Days Out, not a recap and not a game card. The August shape held. The line and the corners are the sentences that changed.
Philo went 16-of-21 both weeks. Faulkner called him cool, calm, and collected, and will coach him through Durkin and the first crowd.
Baugh has been the best back in the country for two weeks without a line that dominated for him. 296 yards, five scores, 14 carries each Saturday, 75 late in the third.
Corners sat nine yards off on 3rd-and-short and have not opened either game with a three-and-out. Byrum Brown will throw it short. Keshaun Singleton will run it.
Honest range is still 7-5 or 8-4. Win Saturday and 3-0 is 1-0 in the SEC, the first one that matches the season they have been pointed at since August.

sources.reporter: Buster Faulkner and Brad White Tuesday
